title: Terraform community support model change - Terraform Cloud required for production
summary: HashiCorp announced that Terraform Community Edition will no longer receive feature updates; production use requires Terraform Cloud/Enterprise subscription. Community edition receives security fixes only.

evidences.excerpt: Terraform will transition to the Business Source License (BSL) v1.1. Terraform Community Edition will be available under BSL, while production use requires Terraform Cloud or Terraform Enterprise.
Repository shows BSL license file added. Community Edition now under BSL v1.1; production use requires Terraform Cloud/Enterprise license.
Download page now prominently features Terraform Cloud/Enterprise for production use. Community Edition labeled 'Development & Testing Only'.

claims.subject: terraform
claims.statement: Terraform Community Edition no longer receives feature updates; production use requires Terraform Cloud/Enterprise subscription
